  "scores": {
    "architecture": 8,
    "behavior": 8,
    "authority_security": 7,
    "validation": 6,
    "overall": 7
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 — Re-derive required command coverage in the completion gate. crates/xtask/src/gate.rs:246-294 checks RunRecord.status, each supplied command status and input fingerprints, but does not require a nonempty/exact manifest-derived command set, validate record schema/subject/kind/run_id against its RunRef, or check exit_code and required nonzero test counts. A self-consistent pre-freeze run marked passed with commands=[] (or a missing host/frontend command, zero tests or a nonzero exit mislabeled passed) satisfies this predicate; the runner normally recording correct statuses does not make the independent gate reject incomplete evidence. Pass the approved expected command plan into the gate and validate identity, coverage, exit/test outcomes and referenced logs. Acceptance: gate-level adversarial cases for empty/omitted/duplicate/substituted commands, wrong subject/kind/run_id, nonzero exit and zero tests all fail with otherwise consistent hashes; actual complete/validate-receipt paths use that validation.",
    "R2 — Validate the complete native acceptance contract and actual prepared artifact. crates/xtask/src/evidence.rs:76-99 accepts any nonempty all-pass checks list and trusts app.fixture; it does not require the C01-N01..N11 matrix, reject duplicate/missing IDs, require observations/evidence, or compare app.identifier to the fixture identifier. gate.rs:307-324 compares the record to a packet-stored executable hash without rechecking the current prepared artifact. Thus one arbitrary passing check with blank evidence, or a production identifier paired with fixture=true, can stand in for the native gate. Bind a versioned required-check inventory, expected fixture identity, evidence references and current executable/bundle hashes to validation. Cover the relevant T09 zoom/large-text/reduced-motion paths when establishing that inventory. Acceptance: removing each mandatory check, duplicating IDs, blank/missing evidence, wrong identity and changing prepared bytes are rejected; a complete real CUA/operator record for the exact fixture passes.",
    "R3 — Preserve and revalidate actual reviewer completion and verdict provenance. review.rs:432-529 adds a fresh Codex nonzero exit to extra_failures and writes a failing receipt, but TransportRecord has no exit/timeout/turn-completion facts and complete.rs re-evaluates the receipt through gate.rs, which ignores those extra failures. With a valid verdict and JSONL naming the request, a failed fresh invocation can therefore be accepted by complete. In addition, gate.rs:217-244 only requires the raw output to contain request_id; it never compares the actual final reviewer verdict to verdict.json, and transport.rs:391-418 can collect any assistant reply naming the request rather than a completed final verdict. Record/hash transport completion facts and compare the actual final structured reviewer result with the file. Acceptance: valid-looking nines followed by nonzero exit/timeout/failed turn, a progress-only reply, and a raw final verdict disagreeing with verdict.json cannot complete; genuine successful thread/fresh results pass.",
    "R4 — Implement predecessor integrity and append-only invalidation/re-review. complete.rs:65-76 and 114-126 treat the presence of Completion and Commit entries as sufficient, without validating their referenced receipts/hashes or matching the commit to that completion generation; gate.rs never validates Packet.predecessors. complete.rs:145-153 also permanently rejects any new completion for an already completed subject. This both permits a deleted/edited predecessor receipt after a dependent review to go unnoticed at completion and makes the documented dependency-update/reopen workflow impossible without rewriting the ledger. Add append-only invalidation/supersession generations, verify predecessor receipt/commit references, and consume only the latest valid generation. Acceptance: missing/tampered/failed predecessor evidence blocks advancement; an affected completed chunk can be rechecked/reviewed and completed under a new generation; old generations and duplicate receipt IDs cannot unlock later chunks/phases.",
    "R5 — Fingerprint the shared source actually consumed. apps/desktop/package.json depends on file:../../.work/academy/packages/presentation, while fingerprint.rs:164-196 hashes .inputs, locks and tool identities, not .work or the resolved installed presentation package. shared.rs:202-221 resets scratch before a check, but test/native/review/complete do not verify the consumed scratch/package bytes against the locked snapshot. Modifying the ignored shared source after checks can therefore leave all four packet fingerprints unchanged while changing what the next build consumes. Bind the resolved shared-package bytes and relevant scratch source/config inputs, or enforce immutable verified consumption before/after every consuming operation. Acceptance: editing a consumed .work presentation/CSS file or its resolved installed copy without changing .inputs/lockfiles invalidates the gate; clean verified staging and both consumers still pass.",
    "R6 — Make the independent bootstrap validator equivalent and causally tested. tools/reference-validator/validate_receipt.py:108-195 recomputes only current source, not current dependencies/build flags/evidence; it also omits receipt-score equality, run failure/coverage checks and native subject/fixture/required-check validation performed or required by xtask. Its adversarial edits to verdict.json do not reseal verdict_sha256, so the score/schema tests can all fail merely on the hash guard. Strengthen the independently implemented validator and test semantic guards with outer hashes consistent, separately from tamper tests. Acceptance: demonstrate the reference validator and controller agree on the same actual corrected C01 receipt and on dependency/evidence/flags changes, incomplete runs/native checks, receipt-score mismatch and each schema/threshold mutation. Retain the genuine bootstrap results before C01 completion.",
    "R7 — Close native observation resources, not just the JavaScript handler. apps/desktop/src/contracts/invoke.ts:16-19 replaces Channel.onmessage with a no-op. The installed Tauri 2.12.4 Channel setter only replaces its handler; cleanupCallback unregisters it separately. desktop_observe in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:140-170 holds the Channel and Subscription in a spawned task with no unsubscribe/window-retirement path. Repeated mount/unmount or renderer reload leaves waiting tasks/subscribers/callbacks alive, and Subscribers::subscribe (crates/desktop-core/src/observe.rs:52-56) has no active-subscription bound. Add a native-owned subscription retirement mechanism and callback cleanup, with a cap/replacement policy and cleanup on failed initial observation, resync and window teardown. Acceptance: repeated production-facade subscribe/unsubscribe and renderer reload retire the native task/subscriber even with no further updates, callbacks are removed, and observation count stays bounded without cancelling business work.",
    "R8 — Keep modal focus valid when native navigation fires. apps/desktop/src/app.tsx:43-47 handles a native navigate command by setting active without closing the palette. DesktopShell then focuses the new heading (desktop-shell.tsx:41-48), while CommandPalette remains open with aria-modal=true and its Tab trap attached only inside the dialog. Opening the palette and invoking native Go/Settings (for example Cmd+2 or Cmd+,) therefore moves focus behind a still-open modal. Close the palette as part of native navigation or explicitly prevent navigation while modal. Acceptance: production App tests deliver native navigation with the palette open and assert a closed dialog plus correct heading focus, or an intentionally retained modal with focus inside; verify the same shortcut path in native acceptance."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Mandatory C01 native acceptance is absent: request.json native_acceptance=null and docs/planning/evidence/C01/native-acceptance.json does not exist. The reported Accessibility/Screen Recording restriction blocks automated T09; use an authorized host with those permissions or an actual operator checklist. Build success, mock tests and startup socket samples cannot replace keyboard/focus/accessibility/theme/resize acceptance.     "No independent C01 bootstrap validate/adversarial results exist in this packet.     "Clean-checkout reproducibility is not established.   ],

    "The selected design requires Rust-persisted desktop appearance (DESIGN.md:361-364), but Core::new initializes Theme::System and SetAppearance changes memory only. Identify the owning implementation chunk and test restart persistence before presenting this as a completed preference; if intentionally deferred beyond C01, document that limitation explicitly.",
    "Tighten presentation runtime validators in packages/desktop-contracts/src/client.ts: parseShellSnapshot/parseMenuCommand accept arbitrary feature IDs and incomplete availability payloads, and snapshot revision lacks the u64 upper-bound check used for sequences. Literal invalid-response fixtures should cover those cases.",
    "shared.rs confines paths with lexical starts_with and validates symlink targets lexically. Normalize/canonicalize the allowed roots and reject ancestor/symlink escapes before destructive scratch cleanup; add cases such as .work/../apps and chained symlink resolution.",
    "The checked frontend log contains an unwrapped React act(...) update warning in the appearance test. Await/wrap the relevant asynchronous update so the evidence is quiet and verifies the actual completed interaction.",
    "Tool hashes currently identify rustup shims for rustc/cargo and the pnpm launcher rather than all backing tool implementations. Consider recording the resolved selected toolchain executables/package integrity as well as the version output.",

  ],
